youtube.title: Why Most Pencils Have Six Sides ✏️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Most pencils are hexagonal because flat sides stop them rolling off desks and give a comfortable grip, and a hexagon packs efficiently, so more pencils can be cut from the same wooden slats with less waste than round ones.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.

#Shorts #science #facts #thehiddenwhy

sources: Smithsonian / pencil manufacturers (Faber-Castell, Dixon): hexagonal barrels resist rolling, aid grip and reduce wood waste per slat
